_doc: v1.2: plan_review_gate (boolean) fires post-tool-use.sh harness P54 gate on Tier 2+ ExitPlanMode; tier2_autonomous (boolean) routes Tier 2 plan approval through Skill(submit-plan-for-review) which writes the P54 marker, runs reviewers, and signs PASS automatically. Both must be true for full autonomous Tier 2 — tier2_autonomous alone is a no-op without plan_review_gate (per pp1 bead + v5.7.213 fanout).
